observations: Photo 0 shows a green and black camouflage-patterned console with a red power brick and a coiled black cable with a USB connector.
Two red boxes labeled 'Wireless Controller' are placed on top of the console.
The console has a visible 'PS4' logo on the front left corner.
The console appears to be a slim model, consistent with the PS4 Slim design.
The background shows a glass display case with various items, suggesting a retail or storage environment.
The watermark 'GAME ARENAOFFICIAL' is visible on the image.

claims.claim: Sony ps4 slim – clean, fast & reliable gaming console
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a PS4 Slim console, but there is no visible proof of cleanliness, speed, or reliability. The console appears to be in a retail setting, but no internal or functional proof is shown.

risks.risk: Console may be non-functional or have hardware issues
risks.proof: A video showing the console powering on, booting up, and running a game or system menu.

risks.risk: Console may be stolen or have a blacklisted serial number
risks.proof: A clear photo of the serial number on the console, ideally from the bottom or back, and a verification check via official Sony or authorized reseller.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially blacklisted or stolen

risks.risk: Controllers may be non-functional or counterfeit
risks.proof: A video showing both controllers connecting to the console and responding to inputs.
risks.if_unproven: priced as controllers may not work

risks.risk: Console may be missing accessories or have damaged ports
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the console's ports and a full view of all included accessories.
risks.if_unproven: priced as possibly missing or damaged accessories

proof_requests: Photo of the sticker on the back or side showing the model, serial or service tag.
Video of the console powering on and booting up.
Video of both controllers connecting and working with the console.
Close-up photo of the serial number on the console.
Photo of all included accessories and ports.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
